title: 2026-10-13 v1: two gpt-6-astra turns, idle ACP switch to Flash, then two Flash turns. steps.prompt: Without tools, find the remainder of 13 to the power 7 modulo 103 by repeated squaring. Give a short calculation.
Without tools, multiply the previous remainder by 17 and reduce modulo 103. Explain briefly.
Without tools, independently find the remainder of 5 to the power 11 modulo 89 by repeated squaring. Give a short calculation.
Without tools, multiply that last remainder by 31 and reduce modulo 89. Give the result and finish with ASTRA-TO-FLASH-V1-DONE.

wire.label: The second destination request must retain the first destination response's native state. Foreign source exclusion is provenance-based and must not strip legitimate new Flash state.
